description: The Global Configuration keys the Integration Sidecar reads (architecture §2.3, implementation §1.2.5).

runtime_interface_range.description: The Node Runtime Interface versions the deployed Integration Sidecar supports: for each major, the highest minor it serves (architecture §2.3, §3.6.1). It comes with the Integration Sidecar, and its default is what the binary speaks.

preconditions.message: runtime_interface_range maps each major, a positive integer, to its highest minor (architecture §2.3)

embedding_model.description: The network's vector space: the egress_registry entry the Embedding Model is reached through, the model requested from it and its prefix convention. It has no default: the network is born without a vector space (architecture §2.3, implementation §1.2.15).

entry.description: The egress_registry key of the Embedding Model.

model.description: The model requested from the entry.

document_prefix.description: The prefix of the capability_text side; empty in a model without prefixes.

query_prefix.description: The prefix of the task's text, the querying side (architecture §3.7.4); empty in a model without prefixes.

preconditions.message: the network opens only with embedding_model assigned (architecture §2.3, §3.18)

egress_registry.description: The egress classes the network has authorized, one entry per key (architecture §3.16.2). An entry declares the target of the embeddings endpoint, reached with no credential (implementation §1.2.15).

target.description: The destination: the root URL, http or https, the operation's path resolves under.

preconditions.message: a target is an http or https URL of a host, an optional port and an optional path, with no credentials, query or fragment (architecture §3.16.2)
